genius.notes: The October 1, 2026 reserve report identifies BRL1 CONSORTIUM S.A. as issuer and explicitly states that it was prepared internally and has not been independently audited. Monthly reserve-report marketing does not establish a monthly independent attestation. GENIUS no-public-authorization and foreign-exception findings were refreshed on 2026-10-07; issuer pathway and foreign qualification remain unknown. Treasury section 3 and substantive federal rules are proposals; the September 30 SCRC rule is procedural. The expected general effective date remains January 18, 2027 and the general DASP restriction begins July 18, 2028. This timing field does not assert unrestricted market access under other law.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, no public GENIUS permitted-issuer approval, state qualification, official GENIUS application, OCC foreign registration, Treasury issuer/jurisdiction comparability determination or token-specific GENIUS enforcement action was located for BRL1, BRL1 CONSORTIUM S.A. and BRL1 Network. This is a bounded public-evidence finding, not proof that no nonpublic filing exists. Foreign-exception eligibility remains unknown; existing foreign AML, banking or corporate status does not establish GENIUS approval.

applicabilityBasis.summary: BRL1 is issued against BRL funding, represented to maintain 1:1 BRL value and burned for redemption in BRL through consortium partners. Its payment and settlement use and fixed fiat redemption support the apparent payment-stablecoin classification; a BRL peg does not exclude the statutory national-currency definition.
